trailhead.label: the car park below the Tuffbad, above St. Lorenzen im Lesachtal, the board’s start

cautions: Alpine tracks and the forest road are open to farm and forestry vehicles.
Cattle may graze the alpine meadows in summer: short lead, give the herd room.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
